clips.title: The story
paras: Hollow Vulture Bones are lightweight, durable skeletal remains harvested from the scavengers of the Shimmering Flats. At the Mirage Raceway, goblin mechanics prize them as specialized building materials to lighten their rocket cars without sacrificing structural integrity.

Speed is everything out on the salt, and weight is the enemy of speed. While standard engineering leans heavily on iron and copper, the goblin pit crews at the Mirage Raceway turn to whatever the desert provides to gain an edge. Vulture bones are naturally hollow yet remarkably sturdy, providing the perfect strength-to-weight ratio for internal brackets, steering rigs, and minor structural supports. For chief tinkerers like Pozzik, harvesting bones from local scavengers is a practical and cheap shortcut to shaved seconds on the track.
